item.title: Scientists reveal the hi
item.guid: 2026-10-15-Scientists reveal the hi
item.description: This is my s&box review. It will be a bit more serious than normal. I think that it is a fine game. The recent changes that are announced sound good. I'm very sorry for Garry for how bad the backlash got, but I'm glad to see he took the feedback and his team is working on it. I think his "Netflix for games" ambition had already been proven to not work as a paid platform just by the existence of Roblox, and how it's not going great for them, even with it being free. Speaking of free, I paid $20 for the game at launch, and played for a few hours. It wasn't my cup of tea. I had played the developer beta beforehand and some games got me, but at launch I was severely disappointed with the amount of AI slop. Now that the game is becoming free, I am glad for new people (and it will be easier to get friends to join) and am a little sad that all I will receive are some exclusive cosmetics, but hey, what are you gonna do? The performance. It does not run great on my computer, which for the most part runs things well. I had to turn everything from high to medium, just because every time I hovered over a different piece of clothing my game would freeze for 5 seconds. Finally, the game being a "successor". It should not have been advertised as Garry's Mod 2. I am glad they tried to steer away from it, but when your steam page describes you as the successor to Garry's Mod, you should expect them to get mad when your game is an engine for developers, and a kind of roblox wannabe. I am glad they are taking the feedback to heart, and overall I believe it is a good game, just very misguided. The thing that has kept me hooked on Garry's mod all these years is that it is a full sandbox, you can grab whatever you want from the workshop and do whatever you want wherever you want, with 20+ years of community and progression. There is no doubt in my mind that s&box will eventually become great, but eventually in the state prior to this announcement, you have to ask yourself if "s&box" is a sandbox game or a sandbox engine. …THANK GOD YOU GOT RID OF THE SAUSAGE PEOPLE. I will make an update article within a year to check in with this game, by the way.

item.title: Mr. Flibble is very cross.
item.guid: 2026-10-13-Mr. Flibble is very cross.
item.description: I’ve been going down a rabbit hole, as I tend to do, and I have gotten obsessed, which I tend to do, with Half-Life for the PlayStation 2. I’ve talked about this version a bit before, but just in passing. The reasons I like it are an enigma to me, but here’s some shit I’ve discovered while going through it. So for the 57th issue of the Official US PlayStation Magazine, the included demo disc contains the half life demo, ‘Uplink’, when you input a cheat code to unlock the extras menu in the base game and then put in the demo disc, it will load up uplink. (I put this on the wikipedia page). Speaking of the cheat codes, they’re all hidden in maps, for example in the Nilanth fight, (spoilers for a 27 year old game) inside the first teleport room, if you crouch under the water, you can find a cheat code there, and in the hazard course, if you look under a platform in the dark room you can find another. Most of these are from supadupaplex, the developer of the Phenomenal Half-Life: Blue Shift PS2 port. They’ve been gone from the internet from around 2023 though, with no activity on any of their accounts. I hope they’re okay. In the meantime, I got that demo disc. It’s pretty neat. Here’s a few other things that aren’t FULLY related, but whatever. For the past TWO YEARS. I have been searching for ONE CD. I’ve been looking for the ‘Half-Life: Further Data’ cd. I have never seen one on ebay, or ANYTHING. None. Nada. Nil. Oh yeah, and: I HAVE AN RSS FEED NOW! Just put in celshaders.com/feed into the app of your choosing and get new posts straight to you! Big thanks to my friend Vivian for helping set it up.

item.title: Come here if you want your tickle touched and your pickle lickled
item.guid: 2026-10-01-Come here if you want your tickle touched and your pickle lickled
item.description: It’s officially the spookiest month of the year! And today I’ll get to tell you about how I almost died because of an amazon item. I have a tv hooked up to a bunch of games. It’s a big interconnected system, where component cables go to a converter to HDMI, and that goes into a 7 input HDMI switch, which goes into a capture card and into my computer and my tv. I got kingdom hearts for the ps2 a few days ago, and when the tv didn’t get any input I thought the capture card or the cable for it was broken. After hours of trying different things I figured out the HDMI switch wasn’t outputting anything. After looking up the brand, the HDMI switcher brand was discontinued and had reviews saying it broke for them after a little while too. So $50 down the drain right? Not a big deal. It sucks that it’s that expensive but whatever. I go to unplug the switch, and the COVER OF THE PLUG COMES OFF SHOCKING ME. THIS SHITTY AMAZON HDMI SWITCH ALMOST KILLED ME BY CREATING THE EQUIVALENT OF A FORK IN A OUTLET. AND NOW I’M DOWN FIFTY DOLLARS. Thank you for listening to my spooky tale. Yes I eventually did play kingdom hearts.

item.title: they put the mamsnrhbr chehfde in the soder
item.guid: 2026-09-13-they put the mamsnrhbr chehfde in the soder
item.description: Something that always interests me are older games with multiple discs, Yeah, I love Tiger Woods for the Gamecube. There’s just something so magical about playing through a part of a game and finding out that was only part of it on one of the discs. Sure, it may be a little annoying, having a break in a game for a few seconds, but it was necessary to fit all that shit in the game. In more modern times, usually a disc for a game downloads a ton of the data, and the disc just acting as a licence, which is bullshit. One that I find interesting is final fantasy 7 on the ps1, which there will be minor spoilers for. In the game, Most of the game part of it is on every disc, the part that took up most of the storage were the full-motion videos, so you COULD swap any disc out for any other, but it would have the wrong cutscenes and have some funny effects. Funnily enough, when they “remade” final fantasy 7, it was only a bit of the first disc, and the second part was the other part of the first disc! Wow! I sure love smaller parts of a story stretched out and changed! (Hey, really quick, I’m not the biggest fan of FFVII remake, as it’s basically the final fantasy 7 equivalent of scott pilgrim takes off, where it changes parts of the story with the same setup and stuff. I like scott pilgrim takes off, but not the remake. Also, I fucking HATE how they’re going to continue making FFVII games, JUST MAKE MORE FINAL FANTASY GAMES. WE DON’T NEED MORE.) Metal Gear Solid is another example of having more than one disc, same with xenogears.

item.title: Amelia Earhart’s famous sweet tooth has doomed us all!
item.guid: 2026-09-10-Amelia Earhart’s famous sweet tooth has doomed us all!
item.description: I am a very humble horse rancher. Today my horses began to act up, jumping up at my house’s windows, ringing the doorbell, as if they were trying to tell me something. One of them wasn't there, and stayed back in the barn. Well, I assumed he was at the barn, because I didn’t see him. After going back to the barn and looking around for almost an hour, Charlie-Horse wasn’t anywhere to be found. But right next to the barn, was a brand new horse stable. The horses began to speak: “Now that we’re at the barn, we can talk to you in your language.” The smallest horse said. Then the big horse walked up and said: “Last night, we prayed to our god, named Source, for a new stable to stay at. Sources… tell me that Charlie is stable. I said: ‘Please god’ but they would not change it. We don’t know what to do to get him back.” The horses pleaded for me to help, but being just a farmer, there was nothing I could do. I prayed to my god, but nothing happened. I tried praying to the horse god, source, but nothing happened. Slowly, my horses started to leave as they too prayed to turn into other things to help the rest of themselves. The small horse became a new trough, The big horse volunteered to become a large supply of food for the remaining ones. Now I was down to my last horse of this barn, the little baby horse. Who only wished for one thing: his family back. Suddenly, the Charlie-horse was back! Then, the small horse! And then the big horse! All the horses were back and vowed to never again wish for things, when they were already well off in my care. This truly was our turning point. USA.

item.title: You're a bunch of DiCaprios, DICAPRIO! DICAPRIO! DICAPRIO!
item.guid: 2026-08-14-You're a bunch of DiCaprios, DICAPRIO! DICAPRIO! DICAPRIO!
item.description:
Sorry for another review so soon, but I recently played through ENDACOPIA by Andyland and I just GOTTA talk about it. [This review will have spoilers later.] ENDACOPIA is a (sort of?) point and click adventure game that makes use of pixel art and 3D graphics. It seems very reminiscent of old point and click adventure games that have somewhat nonsensical solutions to problems. At some points can give you a head-scratcher, but the hint system can help you a LOT when you’re stuck. The characters are all very charming, and the game can give you quite a spook. The soundtrack is amazing (I love the trailer music) and it’s fun to find secret ways to do stuff.
[Spoilers!] Now that you’ve obviously played the game to completion, let’s talk about my playthrough. I’ve heard people saying that there are certain orders to play the game in, but that’s not true, you can play the game’s three main areas in any order, but the house interludes are always in the same order. My first playthough, I went in this order: Misery Town, Corporation(?), and Timesville. And I DO think you should do timesville last, Or at least do a bit of it and then finish one of the other areas, as it is a LOT. When I got the metal detector and that ghost thing started to chase me, I didn’t notice because I was checking a DM. and when I looked back, I saw it creeping towards Mellow. (I SHIT MYSELF!!!!!! :DDD) Anyway this game is good yay back to band

item.title: NO DRACULAS! NO MUMMY! NO ALIEN! NO DUENDE! ACTIVATE ALARM! KILL ON APPROACH!
item.guid: 2026-08-10-NO DRACULAS! NO MUMMY! NO ALIEN! NO DUENDE! ACTIVATE ALARM! KILL ON APPROACH!
item.description:
[This review will have spoilers] A week ago, I got really into a fangame for an ARG, the ARG being INTERLOPER by anomidae, and the fangame being SOURCEVOID ONLINE by 333 SOFTWARE. To save you a 7 hour lore recap, the “source void” is a large interconnected void full of maps from the source engine. Places from games like: Half-life 2, it’s episodes, Portal (I don’t know about portal 2), Team Fortress 2, Counter Strike Source, Garry’s mod (this includes community made maps), as well as others. The game is always online, (hence the name) and you put in “seeds” to spawn in a random location in the void and meet up with your friends in the same location. You can pick up props and use your flashlight, move around, and fall from maps to escape entities that will chase you. These entities include:
Umbrella Men - From the ARG, they act as predators in the void, their presence are made known by a jingle.
VRAD errors - error models that act similarly to Umbrella Men, they also play a sound when approaching.
Zombies/Mimics - When you are killed by an Umbrella Men or VRAD errors, you leave behind a mangled corpse. If you wait around by one of these for long enough they will wake up and begin to chase you.
ALL THE ABOVE ENTITIES WILL CAUSE YOU TO CRASH.
Player Mimics - I have yet to encounter one, other than hearing them several times, but they repeat sentences players say.
Cones - I have seen a cone twice, once where it came back several times. From what I can tell, It acts very similar to a developer, so I am not yet convinced it is an npc. It can spawn in explosive barrels, hover outside a map, Repeat a lot of sentences, like DEAD MAN BAD or KILL MAN BAD.
Trolls - Not a real entity. It was a patreon member, (patreon members can change their models and play sound effects), and one of them went invisible (bug) and played several sound effects.
Overall, the game really makes you feel like you’re in an ARG, and it’s fun to chat with people while you’re falling, and people in the community are very nice. Although the prop-grabbing physics are weird, due to server time,

SUPRISE! It’s a DOUBLE REVIEW! Next up we have BIG WALK by house house. If I were to describe it in once sentence to someone who’s never heard of it, I’d say: “Breath of the Wild, but multiplayer and focused on puzzles.” although it’s a silly way to put it, because there are many more differences. Let’s get negative stuff out of the way first. The voices are pretty quiet sometimes, and it’s weird that there aren’t separate sliders for main audio volume and voice volume. But the update they pushed recently helped with the quiet voices greatly. Now that we’ve gotten the negatives all out of the way, lets move on to what I like about the game. HOLY SHIT THIS IS GAME OF THE YEAR. I played the game with 3 other friends, and so far, we’ve only completed probably 5% of the game. [This is where spoilers may start] We were able to unlock both the 2nd area and the big red tower. We’re working on opening the gondolas. We’ve gotten like 10-11 ‘gourds’ or whatever you call them. We have gotten separated from each other quite a few times, once, my friends went to the red tower before we left the starting area by glitching out somehow, and we kept hitting the flare at the center of the beginner area, and they kept hitting the flare at the top of the tower until we gave up and @’d them in discord to get their asses over here or we will reset the game. (we needed 4 people for the stack puzzle). Another time, one of us got turned around when we left the green tower for the red tower, (we were done for the day and were putting a bunch of garbage in the lost and found) and they got turned around and went BACK to the green tower. We used the megaphone we found to shout all the way across to talk to them, and they used the laser to communicate back. It was only until they started heading over that we remembered all the towers have radio stations on them that act similar to walkie talkies. Anyway, BIG WALK IS GOOD. If you haven’t played it, PLAY IT. DON’T LOOK AT THIS SPOILERED REVIEW!!! JUST SEE THAT I SAID IT WAS MY GAME OF THE YEAR AND TRY IT!!!!!!! GO GO GO.
oh also it was my birthday 5 days ago lol

item.title: I'm so hungry, I could eat an octorock
item.guid: 2026-07-24-I'm so hungry, I could eat an octorock
item.description:
Aw shit have I really not done an update in 10 days?? Well I WAS going to finish my huge reflections on the error of my ways and how that’s made me feel distant from people but is largely the fault of my lack of self confidence, But I might as well just put something else out instead. First up is Splatoon Raiders: It’s everything I wanted for the game. The difficulty is perfect (and it’s hilarious the easy mode is called ‘tourist’), and the gameplay is extremely well designed. It sucks when you fail a raid, especially when you’re a few sublayers down, but the skill points that you earn make up for it, because you can upgrade and go back down! It took some of the rougelike elements from the ‘Splatoon 3: Side Order’ DLC, and mixed that with Salmon Run and Singleplayer modes to create an experience that is definitely worth the (pretty cheap for a nintendo game) $50. The ability to call for other players’ help for a Raid is very helpful, especially if you need just a little bit of a push to finish it. All the little side content you can do is very fun, The crane minigame is cool, and I like how the boxes are exactly where you leave them when you go out. I do wish there were more hairstyles though, hell, the could’ve taken a bunch from Splatoon 3 and it would be fine by me.
Okay, Next up is a game I’ve been getting a lot more into recently, Voices of the Void, I was introduced to it by watching Vargskelethor Joel’s streams on the game, and after watching like 20 of the highlight videos I had to try it for myself. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to call it a horror game, But that doesn’t fully describe it. If I were to try, I’d say it were a spookysimsourcelikesandbox. Several of the events seen tailor made for Joel and they also scare the hell out of me, I don’t want to spoil a lot of the game, But if you want a well crafted spookysimsourcelikesandbox, this is the game for you. Well, I’ve been writing for about 15 minutes, I think that’s enough for today, I’ll get back to work on my other projects now that I’ve figured out how to help myself actually do work.

item.title: Restricted mode has hidden the comments on this video.
item.guid: 2026-07-07-Restricted mode has hidden the comments on this video.
item.description: [SPOILERS FOR DELTARUNE ] Now that it's been a few weeks since deltarune chapter 5 was released, I’ve gathered my thoughts about it. The gameplay is the best of all of the chapters. I REALLY hope that they reuse parts of it in the next chapters, Similar to how the climbing gimmick from chapter 4 was reused quite a bit in this one. I’ve overheard a lot of people saying that asgore was vagueposting near the end of the chapter in his monologue, And while I don’t personally agree with that, (I think it makes since he wouldn’t bring up something that was probably really bad with his child) I can see why some people feel that way, though to me it would feel like a random lore dump. Anyway, all the characters were very enjoyable and extremely funny. I have also heard criticisms about the chapter being too funny and lighthearted for a lot of it , I agree that at some points it can be a bit much, It was always advertised as one last really fun chapter before the storm, (excluding weird route). Speaking of which, The weird route was extremely chilling, Especially the ending and the part where noelle is not speaking, only thinking. The way you abort the route is not by hitting stop but by just not saying proceed fast enough, and the game just continues the normal route with several changes, but what worries me is Susie will still show noelle castle town, and that won’t be good after her going crazy and then thinking it’s a dream. Anyway, continuing with the normal route, the secret boss is one of my favorites, and I really enjoy all of the parallels between Pink and her Body and the Soul and Kris. Overall this is an extremely good and well made chapter, with amazing gameplay and fantastic art, It might be one of the best chapters in the game so far, Although it’s not without flaws.

The name in the center is one “antonio cavalieri junior” which doesn’t bring up anything on google or linkedin, but to be fair whoever he is could just not be on those sites.
